evidence: Current Kew accepts R. maxima as Texas-native.
Texas sources place its native distribution in East Texas/east-central Texas; Austin-area plants at the Wildflower Center are explicitly noted as cultivated and not native to the area.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not count cultivated Austin observations or statewide Texas nativity toward target-zone county presence.

morphology.look_here_first: Use as a nonlocal comparison: giant coneflower is a huge perennial with very large bluish-green mostly basal leaves and towering stems topped by tall dark cones with yellow rays.
diagnostic_traits: large heads with tall elongated dark disk cones
